categories.name: kernel
categories.evidence: Modifies the C and C++ kernel public API and wrapper in src/kernel/ to add a new transaction version accessor.
categories.rationale: Adds `btck_transaction_get_version` to the kernel API, completing the transaction accessor set so clients do not have to manually decode raw transaction bytes. While a useful API completeness improvement for external consumers, it is an incremental addition with no critical dependencies.

categories.name: validation
categories.evidence: Excluded by definition: PRs whose primary subject is the kernel library API belong to kernel and are explicitly excluded from validation when they do not alter validation logic.
categories.rationale: Does not touch consensus rules, chainstate, or validation logic; it only exposes an existing transaction field through the kernel API boundary.
